title: Terraria-accurate mining hits, tink sound, and cracks on every damaged block
player_outcome: Mining feels brisk like Terraria: a copper pickaxe breaks dirt in 2 hits and stone or ore in 3, with special tiles (hellstone, dungeon bricks, hardmode ores, chlorophyte) taking proportionally longer. Too-hard blocks tink. Every damaged block keeps showing staged cracks while its damage lasts, even when you look away.
design: Verified: Health = 100 × hardness (MiningRules.cs:11), so stone takes 150 HP and 5 copper hits. Cracks only draw on the cursor target (TargetHighlight.cs:52, 92). BlockDamageTracker.Active is unused by game/. Too-hard plays dig_* at −8 dB (SoundEvents.cs:184).
MiningRules.Health → a constant TileHealth = 100. Add BlockDef.PickDamageScale (default 1). WorldEditor.Mine multiplies damage per cell by the block's scale; explosions keep 1e6.
Keep 'hardness' only for sound/particle intensity and update its doc comment.
BlockDamageTracker gains a Version counter bumped on Hit/Clear/Prune.

New game/Rendering/BlockCracks.cs: when Version changes (or every 0.25 s for fading), take ≤ 64 active damaged cells within 24 m of the camera into a MultiMesh of 1.02× cell cubes. Per-instance custom data = (stage 0–3 by damage fraction at 25/50/75/90%, fade over the last 60 ticks before forget).

New shaders/block_crack.gdshader, a box decal: back faces, hint_depth_texture world-position reconstruction, discard outside the unit cube, triplanar crack mask from a 4-stage atlas. It works on smooth surface-nets terrain.
Crack atlas: new tools/textures/gen_fx.py (set 'fx' in build_textures.py) writes assets/textures/fx/cracks.png (4 stages, alpha mask).
TargetHighlight stops passing mining progress to the cursor faces (no doubled cracks); the colour ramp stays.
data_changes: pickDamageScale 2: dirt, grass, clay, mud, jungle_grass, mushroom_grass, corrupt/crimson/hallowed grass, sand, pearlsand, ebonsand, crimsand, hardened_sand, silt, snow, slush, ash, hive (soft tiles)
pickDamageScale 0.5: ebonstone, crimstone, pearlstone, hellstone, blue/green/pink_brick, cobalt_ore, palladium_ore
pickDamageScale 0.33: mythril_ore, orichalcum_ore; 0.25: adamantite_ore, titanium_ore, lihzahrd_brick; 0.2: chlorophyte_ore
tests: MiningHitsTests: copper pickaxe (35) breaks stone in 3 hits and dirt in 2; gold (55) breaks stone in 2
MiningHitsTests: cobalt ore at 100 power × 0.5 → 2 hits; hellstone below 65 power → TooHard
Smoke basic.cmds pickaxe hold still yields 'inv.stone >= 8'
verification: Lavapipe: mine partially, look away — cracks stay on smooth terrain and crisp bricks
risks: Depth-texture decals need the Forward+ renderer (project default). Check the low preset still works; fall back to cursor-only cracks on the compatibility renderer.
Faster mining changes smoke expectations that count hits.
